summary: Frontend-only retest completed for subject filtering, created-question persistence, file actions, circular activity indicators, core navigation, and 375px responsive layout. Most fixes pass; one SPA Guardados consistency defect remains.

integration_issues.flow: Save newly created doubt then open Guardados via sidebar navigation
integration_issues.issue: The created question is absent after React SPA navigation to Guardados, although it appears after a full reload. Saved reads only initialQuestions, while the new record exists only in the persisted uao-questions state until interactionPatches runs again on document load.

action_items: Update Saved to derive saved question records from the persisted uao-questions collection (or otherwise synchronize shared question state) so SPA navigation and reload behave identically.
critical_code_review_comments: Saved still filters the immutable initialQuestions import instead of persisted uao-questions; interactionPatches only masks this after a document reload by mutating initialQuestions.

interactionPatches provides MOCKED localStorage/prompt behavior for file actions; these controls show confirmations and persist marker keys, but they do not create a real file resource or expose it in the files list.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST questions and localStorage file markers during browser testing; all data is local/mock-only and no backend data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Programación subject filter passes; new question appears in Guardados after full reload but fails after in-app sidebar navigation. Add file, View file, Save file, and Save resource show visible mock confirmations and persist localStorage markers. Activity dots are circular and 375px has no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: NewQuestion persists uao-questions and QuestionDetail persists uao-saved-questions. Saved initializes its question list from initialQuestions only. The interaction patch syncs localStorage into initialQuestions only at application startup, so a same-document route transition renders Saved with the original seed list and misses newly-created records.
